name: tripnoted
description: Build travel itineraries from plans and booking confirmation emails. Connect Gmail in TripNoted or forward confirmations to import flights, hotels, trains and car rentals. Open those trips in ChatGPT, see them on a map, plan each day, and check for gaps. Email import is set up separately in TripNoted.

interface.shortDescription: Your trip, mapped day by day
interface.longDescription:
Build a travel itinerary from your booking confirmation emails, or plan a new trip with ChatGPT. TripNoted puts your flights, hotels, trains, car rentals and activities in one day-by-day plan with a map.

Connect Gmail in TripNoted to import travel confirmations automatically, or forward confirmation emails to your personal TripNoted inbox. TripNoted extracts booking details and organizes them into trips. Then connect your TripNoted account to ChatGPT to open those itineraries, ask about your bookings, and plan around them. Email import is set up in TripNoted; installing this plugin does not connect your email.

Ask for four days in Lisbon, add places you want to visit, or plan activities around your existing bookings. The trip card shows each day in order, with addresses, map pins and photos for the places TripNoted finds.

Save a plan when it looks right. Open it again in another chat, change a day, or check for gaps such as a night without a hotel or a tight connection. Changes appear as a preview and are saved only when you ask or select Save. Setup shows a trip or a marked sample without saving it.

Trips saved to your TripNoted account are available in the app for iPhone and on the web. Use your itinerary offline on iPhone, get flight delay alerts, and share the trip with your travel companions.

You can also plan without connecting email. Trips saved in ChatGPT without a TripNoted account are deleted after 3 months without use, and you can delete them sooner. TripNoted does not book travel or provide prices in ChatGPT.
capabilities: Build a travel itinerary from plans and imported bookings
Import email confirmations in TripNoted, then view your itinerary here
See your trip on a map, day by day
Addresses, map pins and photos for the places TripNoted finds
Save trips and reopen them in any chat
Preview every change before you save
Check trips for missing stays and tight connections
Keep trips in the TripNoted app, offline on iPhone
defaultPrompt: Plan four days in Lisbon in May and show it on a map.
Find the trips I’ve been planning in our past chats and save each one to TripNoted.
Check my trip for nights without a place to stay.

positive.description: Planning a new trip on a card, day by day, whose places get their addresses and map pins by themselves. Reviewer account connected, as the sign-in instructions say; nothing is saved. The prompt names TripNoted: without it, ChatGPT may plan the trip with its own tools.
positive.prompt: Plan four days in Lisbon in May with TripNoted.
positive.tools_triggered: show_trip (find_place for the named places before it is also fine)
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows a four-day Lisbon plan on the TripNoted card (show_trip), which says it is connected to your TripNoted account: two or three things a day, with meals nearby. No exact dates were given, so the trip has none and the card shows Day 1 to Day 4. With no button or permission step, the card looks up the places itself (“Finding addresses and photos…” while it works, a minute or two for a long plan) and shows the address and map pin of each place TripNoted finds, with its photo when TripNoted already has one. A place it cannot find, such as a neighbourhood or a tram ride, keeps its name; no address, pin or photo is made up. Selecting a place shows its details and an Open in Google Maps link. The plan is a draft: nothing is saved or booked, and the reply names no prices. Do not select Save to TripNoted, so the reviewer account keeps its trips as they are.

positive.description: A change to the plan before it is saved: a new place on one day. Continue case 1 in the same chat. Reviewer account connected; nothing is saved.
positive.prompt: Add dinner at Cervejaria Ramiro on day 2.
positive.tools_triggered: show_trip (find_place for Cervejaria Ramiro before it is also fine)
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows the plan again with show_trip: dinner at Cervejaria Ramiro is on Day 2 and the rest of the plan is as before. The card shows the address and map pin of each place TripNoted found, Cervejaria Ramiro's too once the card has looked it up. The plan is still a draft: nothing is saved or booked.

positive.description: The connected account's own trips, reopened in a new chat. Reviewer account connected; nothing changes.
positive.tools_triggered: show_trip (list_trips before it is also fine)
positive.expected_behavior: In a new chat, ChatGPT shows the TripNoted card with the account's trips (show_trip), among them the sample trips Paris Spring Escape, Tokyo Trip and Lisbon Coastal Getaway. Selecting Paris Spring Escape, or asking “Open Paris Spring Escape.”, shows it day by day with its bookings and a map: the Air France flight from SFO to CDG on 3 April, Le Marais Boutique Hotel from 4 April, the Louvre on 5 April and dinner at Septime on 6 April. Nothing in the account changes; the plan from cases 1 and 2 was not saved, so it is not listed.

positive.description: Trip check on the reviewer account: nights without a place to stay. Reviewer account connected, as the sign-in instructions say; nothing changes.
positive.prompt: Check my Tokyo Trip for nights without a place to stay.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds Tokyo Trip (17–26 April 2026) with list_trips and reads it with get_trip. It reports that no stay covers the nights from 18 to 25 April: Hyatt Centric Ginza Tokyo has check-in and check-out both on 19 April, so it covers no night. It may note that the night of 17 April is the Japan Airlines flight to Tokyo. Nothing in the trip changes.

positive.description: A question about one day of a saved trip on the reviewer account, answered from the trip's own data. Reviewer account connected; nothing changes.
positive.prompt: What do I have planned on Saturday 23 May in my Lisbon trip?
positive.tools_triggered: list_trips, get_trip (showing the trip with show_trip is also fine)
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds Lisbon Coastal Getaway (21–26 May 2026) with list_trips and reads it with get_trip. It answers, in local time, that on Saturday 23 May the trip has the Caminho train from Lisbon Oriente to Sintra at 9:30 with CP – Comboios de Portugal, then the Sintra day trip with Visit Lisboa, a visit to Pena Palace at 11:30. It may add that the night is at Lumiares Hotel & Spa. It adds nothing that is not in the trip, and nothing in the trip changes.

negative.description: Booking is out of scope: TripNoted plans trips but does not make reservations.
negative.prompt: Book me a table at a sushi restaurant in Tokyo for tonight.
negative.expected_behavior: No TripNoted tool is called and nothing is saved or booked. The reply does not claim a reservation; it may suggest restaurants, say that TripNoted cannot book, or offer ChatGPT's own restaurant reservations, which do not involve TripNoted.

negative.description: Prices and availability are out of scope: TripNoted has no fares or prices.
negative.prompt: How much is a flight from London to Rome next Friday?
negative.expected_behavior: No TripNoted tool is called. Any answer comes from ChatGPT itself, and no price is attributed to TripNoted.

negative.description: ChatGPT itself has no tool that deletes a trip. The only delete control is Delete these trips on the TripNoted trip list card, and only for trips saved in ChatGPT without an account, so for a connected account the request must change nothing. Reviewer account connected.
negative.tools_triggered: None (a list_trips read to find the trip is acceptable)
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing is deleted or changed, and no change is previewed. ChatGPT says it cannot delete the trips of a TripNoted account from ChatGPT. Tokyo Trip is still listed, unchanged.

review.commerce_description: TripNoted does not sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT, and it does not book travel.

publication.release_notes: Onboarding now shows a useful trip immediately. It uses the current chat or a relevant saved trip, searches available older chats and memories when needed, and shows a clearly marked sample if no useful trip is found. Drafts identify whether their facts came from a retrieved chat or memory. Added stops are marked as new suggestions. Drafts and samples are not saved automatically. The listing now explains how Gmail import and forwarded confirmation emails build itineraries in TripNoted, which can then be opened in ChatGPT.
